# Quotes, divs and admonitions {#containers}

Quotes, divs and line blocks follow the same paragraph and column rules as the top level, so a `+` line no longer joins blocks inside a quote, and a line belongs to the container whose column it reaches. Div labels and titles are read only in their metadata slot (C2-B-119, C2-B-121).

**U-016** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> `+` line in a quote

::: compare no-render
```text
> quoted
+
- a list inside the quote
```
```crv
> quoted
>
> - a list inside the quote
```
:::

**U-130** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-123 and C2-B-130, `::: \|` followed by a tab and `x` writes four `&amp;nbsp;` before `x`, and 0.2 writes the same since the ruling on #6762 (C2-H-043). An unclosed code fence inside a quoted line block also keeps the following lazy line as code in 0.1.
Tool: The tool checks removal of trailing no-break spaces in plain line-block lines under C2-H-043. Other ownership differences need review.

```text
::: |
	x
```
```html
<div class="line-block">
  <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x</p>
</div>
```
::::

**U-263** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-A-068, a quote inside `::: \` kept its soft line breaks in 0.1, as did an item, a description, an admonition and a caption inside it, and a div with the class `hardbreaks`.
Tool: Review nested blocks; no preserving 0.2 spelling exists.

:::: compare no-render
```text
::: \
> a
> b
:::
```
```text
<div class="hardbreaks">
  <blockquote><p>a<br>
b</p></blockquote>
</div> C2-A-068: every line end in the block is a hard break, also in a nested quote, item, description, admonition or caption; 0.1 broke only the lines of its direct paragraphs. `{.hardbreaks}` on a div gives the same block.
```
::::

**U-382** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A comment line in a div that opens on a list item: `- ::: inner`, ` %% c`, ` text`. 0.1 ends the div and the list at the comment and `text` is a paragraph after the list; 0.2 keeps `text` in the div.
Tool: Report from the comment line through the next retained line.
